title: 第17章 魔教功法你敢修吗？
novel_title: 镇守魔教圣女？我一天涨一年功力
content_zh:
丙字号牢房。

    过道两侧的石壁渗着暗红色的水渍，空气中弥漫着一股陈腐的血腥味。

    陈然拎着沉重的木质饭桶，布鞋踩在湿滑的青砖上，发出轻微的啪嗒声。

    【审讯囚犯雷老虎，参与度提升】

    【获得奖励：功法《狂虎刀法》】

    丹田深处，一股炽热的流光猛然炸开，顺着脊椎直冲天灵盖。

    陈然脚步微顿，脑海中浮现出一尊巨虎。

    巨虎盘踞在尸山血海之上，猛然下山，带起一股惨烈至极的煞气。

    刀势刚猛，每一招都透着有死无生的决绝。

    他收敛心神，指尖摩挲着饭桶边缘，继续朝前走去。

    丙字号总共就十个牢房，其余的牢房都空着，里面的囚犯大多都被斩了，能活下来的基本上都不是死罪。

    除去新进入的雷老虎，整个丙子号里就只有两个牢房还有人。

    所以看守丙字号算上一个清闲的活，俸禄也不低，算是一点福利。

    左侧牢房的精铁栅栏后，两个长相一模一样的汉子正蹲在角落。

    他们穿着破烂的囚服，眼神如受惊的耗子般四处乱窜。

    【姓名：大季、小季（化名）】

    【境界：九品】

    【罪孽值：浅红】

    【生平：双胞胎骗子，合伙诈骗多位权贵，因分赃不均暴露被捕。】

    陈然扫了他们一眼。

    这两个货色正凑在一起嘀咕着什么，看到陈然走近，立刻闭上了嘴。

    “官爷，给口水喝吧。”

    其中一人趴在栅栏上，干裂的嘴唇微微颤抖。

    陈然面无表情，连停都没停。

    这种靠嘴皮子吃饭的骗子，身上榨不出半点油水，纯属浪费口粮。

    他径直走到过道尽头。

    这里的牢房相对干燥，铁窗外透进一抹微弱的晨光。

    铁窗后，一个须发皆白的老者盘膝而坐。

    虽然身陷囹圄，但他那身洗得发白的囚服却被打理得整整齐齐，脊背挺得笔直，如同一柄入鞘的古剑。

    【姓名：苏远山】

    【境界：无】

    【罪孽值：白】

    【生平：原大魏御史，因弹劾权臣勾结魔教，反被诬告入狱。】

    陈然放下饭桶，从桶里取出两个粗面馒头，丢进铁碗里。

    铁碗撞击地面，发出沉闷的声响。

    “苏大人，吃饭了。”

    苏远山缓缓睁开眼。

    那双眼睛清亮深邃，不见丝毫颓丧与怨怼。

    “老夫已非大人，小哥称呼真名便是。”

    苏远山伸手捡起馒头，动作斯文，仿佛坐在金銮殿上参加国宴。

    陈然靠在冰冷的石墙边，看着他。

    “这丙字号关的都是杀人放火的魔头，苏老一介书生，待得惯？”

    苏远山咬了一口干硬的馒头，细细咀嚼后咽下。

    “心中无鬼，何处不是清净地。”

    他抬头看向陈然，自嘲一笑。

    “倒是小哥你，年纪轻轻便在这阴森之地当差，可惜了。”

    陈然盯着他头顶那抹纯净的白色。
content_en:
Cell size C.

    The stone walls on both sides of the corridor were stained with dark red water, and the air was filled with the smell of stale blood.

    Chen Ran was carrying a heavy wooden rice bucket, and his cloth shoes made a slight clicking sound when he stepped on the slippery green bricks.

    [Interrogation of prisoner Lei Hu, participation increased]

    [Reward: Kung Fu "Crazy Tiger Sword Technique"]

    Deep in the dantian, a stream of blazing light suddenly exploded, running straight down the spine towards the Tianling Gai.

    Chen Ran paused slightly, and a giant tiger appeared in his mind.

    The giant tiger was entrenched on the corpse mountain and the sea of ​​​​blood, and suddenly descended from the mountain, bringing with it a tragic and extremely evil aura.

    The sword is fierce and fierce, and every move reveals the determination of life and death.

    He gathered his thoughts, rubbed the edge of the rice bucket with his fingertips, and continued walking forward.

    There are only ten cells in cell number C. The rest of the cells are empty. Most of the prisoners inside have been beheaded. Those who survive are basically not guilty of capital crimes.

    Except for the newly entered Lei Hu, there are only two cells in the entire Bingzi that are still occupied.

    Therefore, guarding No. C can be regarded as a leisurely job, and the salary is not low, which can be regarded as a little benefit.

    Behind the iron bars of the cell on the left, two identical-looking men were squatting in the corner.

    They were wearing tattered prison uniforms and scurrying around like frightened rats.

    [Name: Da Ji, Xiao Ji (pseudonym)]

    [Realm: Ninth Grade]

    [Sin value: light red]

    [Life: Twin swindlers, who worked together to defraud many powerful people, were arrested because of their uneven distribution of the spoils. 】

    Chen Ran glanced at them.

    These two guys were muttering something together. When they saw Chen Ran approaching, they immediately closed their mouths.

    "Master, give me some water to drink."

    One of them was lying on the fence, his chapped lips trembling slightly.

    Chen Ran's face was expressionless and he didn't even stop.

    This kind of liar who lives by his words can't get any profit out of him. It's a waste of food.

    He walked straight to the end of the aisle.

    The cell here is relatively dry, and a faint morning light shines through the iron window.

    Behind the bars, an old man with white hair and beard sat cross-legged.

    Although he was behind bars, his washed-white prison uniform was neatly trimmed, and his back was as straight as an ancient sword sheathed.

    [Name: Su Yuanshan]

    [Realm: None]

    [Sin Value: White]

    [Life: Former censor of the Wei Dynasty, he was falsely accused and imprisoned for impeaching powerful officials for colluding with the demonic sect. 】

    Chen Ran put down the rice bucket, took out two thick steamed buns from the bucket, and threw them into the iron bowl.

    The iron bowl hit the ground with a dull sound.

    "Master Su, it's time to eat."

    Su Yuanshan slowly opened his eyes.

    Those eyes were clear and deep, without any trace of decadence or resentment.

    "I am no longer an adult, so I will call you by my real name."

    Su Yuanshan reached out to pick up the steamed buns with gentle movements, as if he were sitting in the Golden Palace to attend a state banquet.

    Chen Ran leaned against the cold stone wall and looked at him.

    "This number C is all about murderers and arsonists. How can Mr. Su get used to being a scholar?"

    Su Yuanshan took a bite of the dry and hard steamed bun, chewed it carefully and swallowed it.

    “If there are no ghosts in the heart, there is no place that is not pure.”

    He looked up at Chen Ran and smiled to himself.

    "Brother, it's a pity that you are working in this gloomy place at such a young age."

    Chen Ran stared at the pure white above his head.
title_en: Chapter 17 Do you dare to practice the Demonic Cult Techniques?
